breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly reinterpreted a horizontal traction on the vertical edge (x=0) as a tangential shear traction. A horizontal force on a vertical edge is, by definition, a normal traction. The agent repeated this error by explicitly stating to 'Apply a Neumann boundary condition representing a shear traction on the vertical edge x = 0... in the positive x-direction'. The ground truth correctly removed this physically incorrect instruction.
